arStrings.szText: "I'm looking for someone. Have you seen any strangers lately?"
You—did Master send you? He must have heard me complaining! H-He hears everything! I'm sorry, Master! I didn’t mean to be ungrateful! I-It is an honor to be your lowly servant!
Oh, kind, benevolent Master… H-He must have sent you to help me with my task of gathering victuals! Of course! I will lead, and you shall be my bondsman.
C-Come, bondsman. We will gather sweet things to feed to Master, and then he will grant you an audience!
